We project HOU +1.5 on the spread at 70.5% true probability vs 51.9% implied at gtbets — about 32.3% expected value.
On this side, 77% of handle vs 50% of tickets (+27% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No clear reverse line movement on this market.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).

We project NYG +4.5 on the spread at 66.2% true probability vs 50.0% implied at draftkings — about 26.3% expected value.
On this side, 96% of handle vs 30% of tickets (+66% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No clear reverse line movement on this market.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).

We project MIA ML on the moneyline at 44.8% true probability vs 36.0% implied at betfair_ex_eu — about 25.5% expected value.
On this side, 35% of handle vs 12% of tickets (+23% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No opening line stored yet for RLM. The first pipeline run of the week records the current line as the open; later runs compare movement against it.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).

We project DEN ML on the moneyline at 50.8% true probability vs 42.4% implied at bovada — about 16.9% expected value.
On this side, 60% of handle vs 21% of tickets (+39% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No opening line stored yet for RLM. The first pipeline run of the week records the current line as the open; later runs compare movement against it.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).
